Glimmora Mega Evolves for Sturdy and Meteor Beam power, Gholdengo spreads Special Attack drops with Make It Rain, Annihilape sets up with Bulk Up and Drain Punch, Kingambit uses Focus Sash and Swords Dance, Corviknight runs Bulk Up with Mirror Armor, and Milotic provides status and Haze with Competitive. All items are unique and EV spreads maximize two key stats.
